create_ScaleFactor_module: create a ScaleFactor nn.Module to apply variance-preserving scaling to tensor activations
fit_ScaleFactor: fit a ScaleFactor module using collected variance statistics to compute the optimal scale value
observe_ScaleFactor: observe input and output tensor variances during forward pass to collect fitting statistics
set_ScaleFactor: set the scale factor value on a fitted or unfitted ScaleFactor module
reset_ScaleFactor: reset a ScaleFactor module by zeroing its scale factor parameter
